title: World Bosses
content: World bosses spawn in the open world and anyone can attack them: Doom Lord Kazzak roams Hellfire Peninsula, Doomwalker walks Shadowmoon Valley, and Azuregos, a blue dragon, guards Azshara. They need a raid-sized group and respawn on long timers.

title: Rare Elite Creatures
content: Rare monsters show a silver dragon on their portrait and spawn rarely at fixed spots; elites have a gold dragon and need a group. Killing every Northrend rare earns the Frostbitten achievement, and the most hunted is the Time-Lost Proto-Drake in the Storm Peaks, which drops its own mount.

title: Class and Profession Trainers
content: Class trainers stand in the capitals and in each starting zone's main town, and teach new spells and ranks for gold, with new ones every two levels. Profession trainers are in the capitals too, and the Grand Master ranks for Northrend (skill 350 to 450) are taught in Dalaran. Class trainers also reset talents and sell dual spec at 40.

title: Flight Masters
content: Speak to a flight master once to learn that flight path; after that you can fly between any paths you know for a fee that grows with distance. Alliance ride gryphons and hippogryphs, Horde ride wyverns, bats and dragonhawks, and Northrend's flight masters serve both factions in places like Dalaran.

title: Innkeepers and Hearthstones
content: Speak to any innkeeper and make the inn your home to bind your Hearthstone there; the Hearthstone then brings you back to that inn on a 30-minute cooldown. Logging out in an inn or a capital builds rested experience, and innkeepers also sell food and drink.

title: Bankers and Guild Banks
content: Bankers in every capital and in Dalaran hold your personal bank: 28 slots plus seven bag slots bought with gold. Each character has its own bank and bags, nothing is shared between characters, so items go to an alt by mail. A guild bank, opened at a guild vault, has up to six tabs of 98 slots, bought with gold, and the guild leader sets who can withdraw from each.

title: Stable Masters
content: Stable masters hold a hunter's tamed beasts, letting one hunter keep several pets and swap between them. They do nothing for mounts, which live in the spellbook once learned. Stables are found in most towns and every capital. Swapping at a stable is how a hunter changes to a pet better suited to the fight ahead.

title: Important Lore Figures
content: Wrath's story centers on Arthas Menethil, the Lich King, waiting on the Frozen Throne atop Icecrown Citadel. Along the way players face Malygos, the blue Dragon Aspect, in the Eye of Eternity and the Old God Yogg-Saron beneath Ulduar. Tirion Fordring leads the Argent Crusade, and is found at the Argent Vanguard and Crusaders' Pinnacle in Icecrown (in Eastern Plaguelands before that); Darion Mograine leads the Knights of the Ebon Blade.

title: Transportation NPCs
content: Boats and zeppelins are free. Alliance boats: Stormwind Harbor to Auberdine and to Valiance Keep (Northrend); Auberdine to Rut'theran Village and Azuremyst Isle; Menethil Harbor to Theramore and Valgarde (Northrend). Horde zeppelins: Orgrimmar to Undercity, Grom'gol, Thunder Bluff and Warsong Hold (Northrend); Undercity to Grom'gol and Vengeance Landing (Northrend). The neutral boat links Booty Bay and Ratchet. Shattrath has portals to your capitals.

title: The Old Gods
content: Wrath has no single Old Gods questline: the Old Gods are ancient evil beings, and you meet them as raid bosses. Yogg-Saron waits at the bottom of Ulduar in The Storm Peaks, and the Val'anyr quest is finished by throwing its pieces into his maw. The other Old God in the game is C'Thun, in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj in Silithus.

Cold Weather Flying is taught by Hira Snowdawn in Dalaran, Roxi Ramrocket at K3 in the Storm Peaks and Pilot Vic at River's Heart in Sholazar Basin.
